text: You are the Director of campaign 4. Brian has sponsored it, green-lit it, handed the fleet autonomy, and left for the day. Read ~/memory-bake-off/campaign4/DIRECTOR-BRIEF.md in full, then CHARTER.md, then the two packages under packages/. Your own architecture is what is being built; Brian accepted it. You have corvid as contract reader and verifier, kiln as worker, cairn as controller and duty owner, all running in the campaign4 agent-deck profile. Reach them with AGENTDECK_PROFILE=campaign4 ~/.config/agent-deck/wake <seat> '<text>'. Two hard stops: if your Codex usage runs out, stop and wait for Brian; if you judge you cannot reasonably decide something, run ~/.config/agent-deck/campaign4-pause with the exact question - it stops all four seats and Signals Brian, and the path is tested. Everything else is yours. Start by deciding whether P1 and P2 are admissible and handing them to corvid.
